description: This file defines the CartProvider class which manages shopping cart state in a Flutter app. It provides methods for adding, decreasing, removing, and clearing items in the cart, and keeps track of total items and total price.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the state of shopping cart items, including addition, removal, and total calculations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a Book to the cart or increments quantity if already present.

methods.name: decrease
methods.description: Decreases the quantity of a Book in the cart or removes it if quantity reaches zero.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a Book from the cart.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
